description: Oil-style painting of an inauguration. In the foreground an open Bible rests on a dark carved wooden lectern whose front bears a round seal with lettering around its rim. Behind it, seated dignitaries in dark suits sit under red, white and blue bunting and flags, with microphones at the lectern. A large white domed building, which looks like the US Capitol, stands in the background, and a large crowd fills the right side under an overcast grey sky.
reason: The lectern seal has legible lettering painted around its rim ("PRESIDENT OF THE UNITED STATES" and "SEAL"), which breaks the no-text rule. Repaint the seal blank or cropped so no words are readable. The rest of the scene (Capitol, bunting, Bible on lectern, crowd, no identifiable person) matches the card.
